summary: AEP Texas Inc. filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for a public offering of Senior Notes, Series R, under its existing shelf registration. Terms including principal amount, coupon, maturity, and offering price are left blank in this preliminary filing, with interest payable semi-annually beginning 2027 and delivery expected book-entry via DTC in November 2026. Notes are unsecured, rank pari passu with other senior unsecured debt, carry optional make-whole redemption and a 101% Tax Credit Event redemption. Joint book-runners are CIBC, MUFG and PNC. This is a routine debt capital-markets takedown, not a special situation; watch final pricing and spread.
